title: Umbel cursor, version 1
description: A sealed position in one space's event stream (phase 5 section 9.3, D125): v1. and the unpadded base64url of an XChaCha20-Poly1305 seal of { space, seq } under state/keys/cursor.key, with the caller's principal as associated data and the 24-byte nonce the first 24 bytes of HMAC-SHA256 under a key derived from it over the plaintext and associated data (an SIV construction: equal positions seal equal for one principal). The nonce and the 16-byte tag make at least 41 bytes, so at least 55 characters; 256 characters bounds any space id and sequence number. Handed to every caller that is not process; refused for another principal with INVALID_CURSOR, as a malformed one is. Version 0 strings stay valid from process callers (stdio and the CLI), and stored cursor files keep positions.
